title: v0.9.3 - Advanced Scalability & Client Performance
description: This release focuses on high-concurrency performance, introducing minute-based refresh logic, background activity suppression, and intensive code splitting. It also highlights the new Data View system for spreadsheet-native database interaction.

items.title: Data View System
items.description: A standalone, persistent way to interact with database data.
details: Persistent State: Create 'Data Views' from any table or query that persist across sessions.
Spreadsheet Native: Full collaborative editing with a spreadsheet-like interface powered by the Pegasus Engine.
Sync on Demand: Changes are staged and pushed to the cloud only when you're ready, reducing redundant writes.

items.title: High-Efficiency Refresh Cycles
items.description: Moving system pressure from seconds to minutes.
details: Extended TTLs: Increased cache durations for schemas, user profiles, and settings from 1m to 5m.
Reduced Polling: Background workers (stocks, weather, and cloud sync) now cycle in minute increments, lowering baseline I/O by 80%.
Live-Sync Throttling: Minimum sync interval for 'Live' cloud connections increased to 2 minutes for improved stability.

items.title: Shallow Schema Discovery
items.description: Near-instant connection times for large-scale data sources.
details: Lazy Fetching: The backend no longer introspects every table's columns during initial connection.
On-Demand Introspection: Table schema and sample data are now fetched only when a table is expanded or opened.
Manual Refresh: Added 'Refresh Details' to the context menu for granular, forced updates of specific tables.

items.title: Intelligent Code Splitting
details: Lazy Components: Heavy libraries like Handsontable and Monaco Editor are now dynamically imported only when their respective views are activated.
Reduced Payload: Initial load size reduced by ~40% for the main workspace view.

items.title: Background Activity Suppression
items.description: Pegasus now respects your system resources when in the background.
details: Visibility-Aware Sync: Real-time collaboration events (cursors, typing indicators) are paused when the Pegasus tab is inactive.
Low-Power Mode: Suppresses background refresh timers and heartbeat events when the application is not in focus.

items.title: UI & Logic Consistency
items.description: Hardening the explorer and workspace experience.
details: Resolved a syntax error in the Explorer Schema composable preventing metadata refreshes.
Fixed a bug where collaborative cursors would persist after the user navigated away from a dashboard.
Corrected throttle intervals to ensure smooth interaction while maintaining low network overhead.
